finding: The invoice list builds style + workspace JSX in a local content binding, then returns an embedded/ScreenShell conditional. The generated list had no surrounding NativeWorkspaceStyleScope; only the sibling run-screen export had one.

evidence.visuallyConfirmed: Default stacked controls and unstyled heading instead of the existing invoice CSS.

correction: Wrap prebuilt JSX variable initializers in their native CSS scope before they are returned, forwarded as children or selected by a conditional. The original conditional/logical return control flow stays intact.

checks.actualScreen: InvoicesListScreen embedded and standalone at 360px/1.6 and 1280px/1; actual compiled invoice CSS and action delivery.
checks.browser: The real ready invoice route must retain the authored horizontal tab row at all three existing viewports.

regeneration: A temporary handover step uses the existing CI generator only after the strict source check fails. It exports the changed native source files for a separate review/commit; the strict check stays failed until those outputs are committed. Remove the temporary step when committing the outputs.

baselineCi173.limits: The prior audit did not assert invoice stylesheet attachment; its green result does not clear the newly observed unstyled invoice page.
